name: can_release
notes: Gentle put-down for when the human declines the fling while the arm is holding the can (can_pickup's carrying pose). Lowers a little in joint4, opens the jaws well past the 66 mm can at 9.3 %/s (hardware cap 12), lets it drop the short distance to the table, then returns to its own start pose with jaws at 88 neutral. All joint2/joint3 offsets are >= 0 (soft floors) and the gesture ends where it began — same sag-proof rule as can_fling. JOINT1 ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT (base clamped).

waypoints.label: open — let the can go gently
back to the start pose, jaws neutral
